description: This PHP source file defines a trait 'LDAPConnectionHelperTrait' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Tests\LDAP'. The trait provides utility methods for handling LDAP server configuration, including checking if the LDAP server is configured and retrieving configuration details from a YAML file.

methods.name: isLDAPServerConfigured
methods.description: Returns a boolean indicating whether the LDAP server configuration file exists and is accessible.

methods.name: getLDAPServerConfig
methods.description: Returns an LDAPServerConfig object initialized with parameters parsed from the YAML configuration file.

methods.name: getLDAPServerConfigFilePath
methods.description: Returns the file path to the LDAP server configuration YAML file.
